4687-4702-5296.notablePrerequisites: Workhorse has at least four counters on it.
4687-4702-5296.description:
Activate Splinter Twin by tapping Gilder Bairn, producing its effect.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Workhorse.
Activate Workhorse as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least three mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Workhorse, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

372-1090-3563.manaNeeded: {5}{W}{W} plus enough mana to pay commander tax, if applicable
372-1090-3563.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {4}{W} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Restoration Angel until Abedl Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Cast Flicker of Fate by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves and enters the battlefield, causing Restoration Angel to return to the battlefield from exile, and triggering Abdel Adrian and Restoration Angel's enter abilities.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Restoration Angel until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Restoration Angel trigger, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 4.

1061-7393-7715.easyPrerequisites: You control a Shard that doesn't have summoning sickness.
1061-7393-7715.description:
Activate Niko by paying {2} and tapping it, exiling Timestream Navigator and causing Shards you control to become a copy of Timestream Navigator until the end step.
Activate a Shard by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it from the battlefield onto the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of the next end step, Timestream Navigator is returned from exile to the battlefield. The Mighty Thor then triggers, blinking Niko.
When Niko enters, it triggers, creating two Shard tokens.
Repeat each turn.

5078-6650-7693.easyPrerequisites:
The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
Armor Wars' second chapter ability has resolved this turn.
5078-6650-7693.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

193-2724-3080-4450-5299.description:
Cast Exchange of Words by paying {1}{U}{U}.
When Exchange of Words enters, it triggers, exchanging the text boxes of itself and Wormfang Manta.
Activate Aminatou by putting 0 loyalty counter on them due to Carth the Lion, blinking Exchange of Words.
When Exchange of Words leaves the battlefield, its ability from Wormfang Manta's textbox triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
When Exchange of Words enters, it triggers, exchanging the text boxes of itself and Wormfang Manta.
Repeat from step 3 each turn.

876-1157-7070--32.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting the Eldrazi.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the Eldrazi.
Lightning Greaves's ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the Eldrazi from exile by paying {0} due to Eye of Ugin.
Repeat.
876-1157-7070--32.notes: The chosen Eldrazi must be colorless.

1563-2351-4478-6460.easyPrerequisites:
You control a token.
It is an opponent's turn.
1563-2351-4478-6460.description:
Activate Hardened Tactician by paying {1} and sacrificing a token.
If you sacrificed a Tentacle, The Watcher's second ability triggers if the creature token was a Tentacle, untapping a Kraken and putting a stun counter on up to one nonland permanent.
Resolve the Hardened Tactician ability, causing you to draw a card.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Activate the Tentacle by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

969-3259-7354.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
969-3259-7354.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Endless Foot Assault as attackers.
Endless Foot Assault triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

4217-4924-7101.description:
Cast Airbending Lesson by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target(s).
Holding priority, cast Lutri by paying its mana cost reduced by Heartless Summoning.
When Lutri enters, it triggers, copying Airbending Lesson targeting Lutri.
Resolve Airbending Lesson, airbending Lutri.
Holding priority, cast Lutri from exile by paying {0} due to Heartless Summoning.
Repeat from step 3.

1718-1796-4477-7182.description:
Cast Greenwarden of Murasa for its evoke cost by paying {2} due to Centaur Omenreader.
When Greenwarden of Murasa enters, its first ability and evoke abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, returning Catalyst Elemental from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the second trigger, sacrificing Greenwarden of Murasa.
When Greenwarden of Murasa dies, Ashling triggers, creating a token copy of Greenwarden of Murasa with haste.
When the Greenwarden of Murasa token enters, it triggers, returning Greenwarden of Murasa from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Catalyst Elemental by paying {R} due to Centaur Omenreader.
Activate Catalyst Elemental by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
When Catalyst Elemental dies, Ashling triggers, creating a token copy of Catalyst Elemental with haste.
Activate the Catalyst Elemental token by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.
1718-1796-4477-7182.notes: If you have at least {2}{R} in your mana pool on a particular iteration, step 10 can be skipped.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3899-4552-6441-7170.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Living Brain.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

4331-4993-5116-6259.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Gilded Lotus.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {0}.
Repeat.

147-997-6816.description:
Cast Infuse with Vitality by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Infuse with Vitality, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Infuse with Vitality.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Woe Strider abilities from step 5.

2842-3944-5220-6900.description:
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it.
When Blood Pet dies, Mortuary and Blood Artist trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Blood Pet from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Blood Pet from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

3734-4375-4779.description:
Cast Technomancer by paying {5}{B}{B}.
When Technomancer enters, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards and return Phyrexian Metamorph from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
When Phyrexian Metamorph enters, it triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Phyrexian Metamorph.
Resolve the Phyrexian Metamorph trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Phyrexian Metamorph from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
Repeat from step 3.

4017-4476-5641.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4017-4476-5641.description:
Gain life.
Basking Broodscale triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Answered Prayers triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1283-2797-3918.description:
Activate Trazyn using Chromatic Orrery's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Trazyn using Retrofitter Foundry's ability by paying {3}, untapping it.
Repeat.
1283-2797-3918.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can use Retrofitter Foundry's other abilities via Trazyn.

222-527-1753-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee, adding {G}.
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {B}{R}{G}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Selvala, adding {1}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1780-4499-4893.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {1}, blinking Burdened Aerialist.
When Burdened Aerialist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2034-4871-5695-6019.description:
Cast Infested Thrinax by paying {3}{B}{G}
When Infested Thrinax enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to create a number of 1/1 Saproling creature tokens when a nontoken creature you control dies.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Scourge of Nel Toth, adding {C}{C}.
When Scourge of Nel Toth dies, Infested Thrinax and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Infested Thrinax trigger, creating six 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Saproling, adding {C}{C}.
When the Saproling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Cast Scourge of Nel Toth from your graveyard by paying {B}{B} and sacrificing two Saprolings.
When the Saprolings die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Repeat from step 3.

1799-5296-5795.manaNeeded: {4} minus {1} for each +1/+1 counter on Workhorse
1799-5296-5795.description:
Activate Workhorse by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}.
Repeat step 1 until Workhorse dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Activate Barkform Harvester by paying {2}, putting Workhorse from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Workhorse from the bottom of your library into your graveyard, and then putting it onto the battlefield with four +1/+1 counters on it due to its static effect.
Repeat.

1432-2821-3028-3201.notablePrerequisites:
Ioreth of the Healing House does not have summoning sickness.
Arixmethes is a creature and does not have summoning sickness.
1432-2821-3028-3201.description:
Activate Nissa's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing Minamo to become a 5/5 Elemental creature with haste that's still a land until your next turn.
Activate Arixmethes by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U} and tapping it, untapping Ioreth of the Healing House.
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House's second ability by tapping it, untapping Minamo and Arixmethes.
Repeat from step 2.

1850-2507-4543.description:
Activate Trench Behemoth by returning Jwar Isle Refuge from the battlefield to your hand, untapping it.
Play Jwar Isle Refuge, triggering it and Fastbond.
Resolve the Jwar Isle Refuge trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Fastbond trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Repeat.

294-4659-5003.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Iron League Steed, adding {C}{C}.
When Iron League Steed dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Iron League Steed from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Iron League Steed enters the battlefield, its fabricate ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1833-3581-4053.description:
Activate Kykar by sacrificing Stormbound Geist, adding {R}.
Stormbound Geist dies, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the batltefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

500-851-2047-3129.notablePrerequisites: You control a nonlegendary artifact creature that does not have Mechanized Production attached.
500-851-2047-3129.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mechanized Production triggers.
Holding priority, cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying a nonlegendary artifact creature you control and creating eight token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
Resolve the Mechanized Production trigger, creating a token copy of the artifact it is attached to, and causing you to win the game.

372-4812.description:
Cast Animate Dead by paying {1}{B}, returning Abdel Adrian from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Animate Dead to it.
Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, exiling Animate Dead until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Animate Dead triggers, causing you to sacrifice Abdel Adrian.
Animate Dead returns to the battlefield, returning Abdel Adrian from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Animate Dead to it.
Repeat from step 2.

579-1247-4474.notablePrerequisites:
Paradise Mantle attached to Pili-Pala.
Pili-Pala does not have summoning sickness.
579-1247-4474.description:
Activate Pili-Pala using Paradise Mantle's ability by tapping it, adding two mana of any one color.
Activate Pili-Pala's other ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding two mana of any one color.
Repeat.
